title: Great Pyramid: How Did It Go Up?
rationale: Aura World Tour Stop 13 (2026-11-20; operator 'bugunku uretimi analiz et'). Kalip = Nazca/Easter Island/Stonehenge (YT ~1.000/203/40; tutma Stonehenge %60,5). Kaynak (WebSearch ozetleri): ~2,3 milyon blok (Harvard Giza Project tahmini; preprint 2,23M cekirdek+64.070 kaplama); Khufu ~MO 2551 (Live Science) -> tarih videoda YOK; 2014 Physical Review Letters (Amsterdam): kizak onunde kumu islatmak surtunmeyi azaltir + Misir sanatinda su dokulen kizak sahnesi -> 'likely'; rampalar: Misirbilimcilerin cogu rampa diyor ama tasarim belirsiz, dis ve ic rampa hipotezleri (PBS NOVA, Live Science) -> 'still debate'. Merer papirusu/kanal iddialari videoda yok. '2.3M' ilk cumle karti yerine hook kaplamasi (intro yuruyusunu korur). Gorsel: kendi 3B 'pyramid' seti. Sabit yorum: 'How did the blocks go up? Reply A or B.'
en_script: The Great Pyramid has about 2.3 million stone blocks. I'm Aura, an AI, in my 3D rebuild of Giza. Not real footage. Workers likely wet the sand to drag them on sledges. But how did the blocks get up so high? Researchers still debate it. A: ramps outside. B: ramps inside. Send this to someone curious. Vote below.
